simple.meaning: קֶסֶם (qeçem) is a Hebrew action word meaning “a lot ; also divination (including its fee), oracle.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 11 times in Numbers, Deuteronomy, 1 Samuel, 2 Kings, Proverbs, and 2 more, beginning at Numbers 22:7. The surrounding contexts include birth, family line, kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קֶסֶם (H7081) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: קֶסֶם (qeçem) / H7081 is traced through Numbers 22:7, Numbers 23:23, Deuteronomy 18:10, 1 Samuel 15:23 with source-language evidence and verse context.

occurrences.englishText: The elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the rewards of divination in their hand. They came to Balaam, and spoke to him the words of Balak.
Surely there is no enchantment with Jacob;
There shall not be found with you anyone who makes his son or his daughter to pass through the fire, one who uses divination, one who tells fortunes, or an enchanter, or a sorcerer,

For rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft, and stubbornness is as idolatry and teraphim.* teraphim were household idols that may have been associated with inheritance rights to the household property. Because you have rejected Yahweh’s word, he has also rejected you from being king.”
They caused their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire, used divination and enchantments, and sold themselves to do that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, to provoke him to anger.
Inspired judgments are on the lips of the king.

Then Yahweh said to me, “The prophets prophesy lies in my name. I didn’t send them. I didn’t command them. I didn’t speak to them. They prophesy to you a lying vision, divination, and a thing of nothing, and the deceit of their own heart.
They have seen falsehood and lying divination, who say, ‘Yahweh says;’ but Yahweh has not sent them. They have made men to hope that the word would be confirmed.
Therefore you shall no more see false visions, nor practice divination. I will deliver my people out of your hand. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.’ ”
the Lord Yahweh says: “Remove the turban, and take off the crown. This will not be as it was. Exalt that which is low, and humble that which is high.
I will overturn, overturn, overturn it. This also will be no more, until he comes whose right it is; and I will give it.” ’
